review_notes: I read the whole file (lines 1–124). Within it, the two proofs of `isColimit_conePullbackCocone_underlying` and `preservesLimit_fromSpaceCone` share only a short pattern. That pattern is `ofIsoColimit (Cocone.ext (Iso.refl _) …)` followed by a `change` and a single `exact` of an existing lemma. Each use applies a different lemma (`conePullbackCocone_forget_ι` and `coneOfPullbackCocone_π_mate`) to a different cocone, so there is no shared nontrivial reasoning to extract. The later declarations, `preservesCofilteredLimit` and `preservesCofilteredLimitsOfShape`, are thin wrappers. A grep found the same `Cocone.ext (Iso.refl _)` pattern in `SheafCohomology/AbelianForget/LimitPreservation.lean`. That file is an acknowledged adaptation for a different coefficient category. Unifying the two would need a generalization across categories, and I did not read it closely enough to show rewritten uses under the actual hypotheses, so I report no finding. I did not inspect the imported API files in detail.
